Summary: Dermatology Partners (a PA/DE/MD-based dermatology group practice) disclosed that an unauthorized individual accessed its data system at its Catonsville, MD office between Feb 27 and Mar 10, 2026. The company found no evidence data was copied/removed but could not rule out that records were viewed, so it notified all patients seen at that location.

summary: Dermatology Partners, a dermatology group practice with 30+ offices in Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland, disclosed that an unauthorized individual gained access to its data system at its Catonsville, Maryland office between February 27 and March 10, 2026. The company found no evidence data was copied or removed but could not rule out that patient records were viewed, and notified all patients seen at that location. Potentially viewable data included names, dates of birth, addresses, contact information, medical record numbers, dates of service, diagnosis and treatment information, and possibly health insurance information.
